content:
One thing which annoyed me in the past, was that I don't know a good pattern to write tests for Lean scripts located inside mathlib4/scripts/. One reason was that it wasn't possible to add a separate test file and import the script as scripts/ is not part of a lean_lib. The workaround, e.g. in scripts/autolabel.lean, was to mix the tests and the script and put everything into one file, but this isn't really great.

Would anybody know a good pattern for separating tests from the scripts?
